overlay.behavior: Polls the bounded input ring after each present attempt, converts PS/2 keyboard, mouse, joystick and focus records into SDL events, and maps MiSTer joystick buttons through the keyboard-controller path. Input tracing is opt-in through DIABLO_MISTER_INPUT_TRACE=1.

artifact.elf: ELF32 ARM EABI5 PIE, dynamically linked, /lib/ld-linux-armhf.so.3, stripped

target_contract.board_execution: pass; fresh-RBF board session logged keyboard, mouse and joystick input records in the real ARM engine with arm=1, fpga=1 and fault=0; see arm-input-sdl-bridge-20260907.json

scope_limit: This build and its deterministic injector validate the ARM input-to-SDL bridge. Physical peripherals, live HDMI/audio, overflow snapshot recovery, deterministic gameplay equality and the approximately 60 FPS gate remain open.
